Elsevier CAS Bundle 2.4 (2024-05-04)
Source: https://mirrors.ctan.org/macros/latex/contrib/els-cas-templates.zip

The complete upstream archive is retained unchanged, with its documentation,
examples, manifest and license notices. The manuscript directory contains
verbatim copies of the classes, common style, BibTeX style and thumbnail icons.
The CAS files retain their upstream LPPL notices; the project MIT license
does not replace them. See README and manifest.txt for upstream terms.
